blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: A patient's pathology case spans tens of slides from distinct specimens and anatomical sites, each carrying non-redundant, site-specific evidence. Forming a patient-level conclusion therefore requires locating the slides relevant to a given question and integrating complementary findings across them. However, existing pathology agents analyze one slide at a time and describe morphology rather than measure it, leaving evidence acquisition across a patient's specimens and patient-level quantification underexplored. To address this gap, we propose PlanPath, an agentic framework for patient-level pathology visual question answering (VQA). PlanPath turns the question into an exploration plan that specifies the evidence required, routes to the slides likely to carry it, and drives coarse-to-fine acquisition from tissue architecture down to individual cells. Tissue- and cell-level tools supply the counts, proportions, and extents, which PlanPath aggregates across slides into a traceable answer. To enable evaluation, we build two patient-level VQA datasets for renal and gastric cancer, averaging 15 WSIs per patient, with pathologist-verified question-answer pairs derived from diagnostic reports. Experimental results show that PlanPath outperforms the strongest baseline by 9.4% and 12.1% in overall accuracy on the two datasets and further improves existing slide-level agents when plugged into our framework. The dataset and code are available at: https://github.com/JSGe-AI/PlanPath_1.
blocks.zh: 患者的病理病例会从不同的标本和解剖地点取出数十个滑道,每个滑道都携带非多余的,具体地点的证据. 因此,要得出患者一级的结论,就必须确定与特定问题有关的幻灯片的位置,并综合它们之间的补充结论。 然而,现有的病理剂一次分析一幅幻灯片,描述形态而非测量,使得患者标本上的证据获取和患者水平的量化不足被挖掘. 为了弥补这一差距,我们提出PlanPath,作为病人一级病理视觉问题回答的代理框架。 PlanPath将问题变成一个勘探计划,其中具体说明所需证据、通往可能携带这些证据的幻灯片的路线、以及推动从组织架构到单个细胞的粗到细的获取。 组织和单元格级工具提供计数、比例和范围,PlanPath将各幻灯片汇总成可追踪的答案。 为了能够进行评价,我们为肾癌和胃癌建立了两个患者一级的VQA数据集,平均每名患者15个WSI,其中病理学家验证的对答来自诊断报告. 实验结果表明,PlanPath在两个数据集上的总体准确度超过了最强基线9.4%和12.1%,并在插入我们的框架时进一步改善了现有的幻灯片级剂。 数据集和代码见:https://github.com/JSGe-AI/PlanPath_1。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
Recent advances in pathology foundation models and vision–language models have improved morphological representation and image–text alignment in computational pathology, providing reusable technical foundations for whole-slide image (WSI) understanding ( Chen et al., 2024b ; Lu et al., 2024b ) . Building upon these capabilities, pathology agents powered by large language models (LLMs) can autonomously localize relevant regions, invoke specialized analysis tools, and integrate diagnostic findings in response to clinical questions ( Chen et al., 2025a ; Ghezloo et al., 2025 ) .
These approaches have demonstrated promising performance on slide-level tasks while making the visual evidence behind their conclusions more explicit.
blocks.zh:
最近在病理学基础模型和视觉-语言模型方面的进步改善了形态表现和图像-在计算病理学中的文字相接,为全滑行图像的理解(Chen等,2024b;Lu等,2024b)提供了可再利用的技术基础。 在这些能力的基础上,由大型语言模型(LLMs)提供动力的病理剂可以自主地使相关区域本地化,引用专业分析工具,并结合诊断结论应对临床问题(Chen等,2025a;Ghezloo等,2025.).
这些方法显示出在幻灯片级别任务方面的良好表现,同时使其结论背后的视觉证据更加明确。

blocks.en: However, to better translate these advances into clinical diagnostic practice, pathology analysis should move beyond individual slides toward the patient level. Such analysis can integrate complementary evidence distributed across distinct specimens and anatomical sites, thereby providing a more complete and clinically representative characterization of a patient’s pathological state. Nevertheless, this setting remains relatively underexplored in existing studies. To bridge this gap, we formally define patient-level pathology visual question answering (VQA) as the task of generating a patient-level answer with explicit visual grounding from a patient’s collection of slides and a diagnostic question through cross-slide, multiscale evidence acquisition.
blocks.zh: 然而,为了更好地将这些进步转化为临床诊断实践,病理学分析应该超越个人滑向病人水平. 这种分析可以把分布在不同的标本和解剖地点的补充证据结合起来,从而对病人的病理状态提供更加完整和具有临床代表性的特征。 然而,在现有的研究中,这一背景仍然相对没有得到充分利用。 为了弥补这一差距,我们正式将患者层面的病理视觉问题回答(VQA)定义为通过跨滑坡,多尺度取出证据,从患者收集的幻灯片和诊断问题中产生一个患者层面的答案,并有明确的视觉基础。

blocks.en:
Despite their effectiveness in slide-level analysis, existing pathology agents ( Sun et al., 2026 ; Lyu et al., 2025 ) remain limited for patient-level tasks.
A naive extension is to aggregate answers independently generated from individual slides.
However, such aggregation has a fundamental limitation: it neither selects question-relevant slides nor integrates complementary evidence across them (Fig. 1 b).
This is critical because different patient-level questions often have different evidence requirements, while the relevant evidence is unevenly distributed across a patient’s slide collection ( Koyun et al., 2026 ; Huang et al., 2026 ) . Effective patient-level analysis therefore requires first identifying slides relevant to the given question and then integrating complementary evidence across them , rather than treating individual slides as independent units of analysis (Fig. 1 c).
blocks.zh:
尽管在滑行级分析中有效,但现有的病理剂(Sun等,2026;Lyu等,2025)在病人级任务上仍然有限.
一个天真的扩展是将单个幻灯片独立生成的答案集合起来.
然而,这种汇总有其根本的局限性:它既不选择与问题有关的幻灯片,也不整合它们之间的补充证据(图1b)。
这一点至关重要,因为不同的患者级别问题往往有不同的证据要求,而相关证据在患者的幻灯片收集中分布不均(Koyun等,2026;Huang等,2026). 因此,有效的病人水平分析首先需要确定与特定问题有关的幻灯片,然后综合这些幻灯片之间的补充证据,而不是将个人幻灯片作为独立的分析单位(图1c)。

blocks.en:
Beyond slide selection, patient-level diagnosis often relies not only on the presence of pathological findings, but also on their quantitative characterization, including their amount, proportion, extent, and distribution. For example, the Gleason score of prostate cancer is determined by the relative proportions of its predominant and secondary patterns ( Van Leenders et al., 2020 ) .
Existing pathology agents ( Sun et al., 2026 ; Yang et al., 2026 ) reason over a limited set of local observations; while they can recognize local morphology, they struggle to translate it into reliable patient-level quantitative conclusions. Effective patient-level analysis therefore also requires quantifying findings and aggregating them across slides at appropriate spatial scales.
blocks.zh:
除了幻灯片选择外,病人一级的诊断往往不仅依赖于病理结果的存在,而且还依赖于其定量特征,包括其数量、比例、范围和分布。 例如,前列腺癌的格莱森分数由其主要和次要模式的相对比例决定(Van Leenders等,2020年)。
现存病理剂 (Sun等, 2026; Yang等, 2026) 以有限的局部观测结果为理由;虽然它们能识别出局部形态,但难以将其转化为可靠的患者层次定量结论. 因此,在病人一级进行有效的分析,还需要对结果进行量化,并在适当的空间尺度上将结果通过幻灯片汇总。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Comparison of slide-level and patient-level pathology VQA. (a) A slide-level agent performs well on single-slide questions. (b) Directly applying slide-level agents to multiple slides lacks effective slide selection and cross-slide reasoning. (c) PlanPath addresses patient-level questions through exploration planning, slide ranking, and cross-slide evidence integration.
blocks.zh: 图1:幻灯片水平和病人水平病理比较 VQA. (a) 幻灯片级代理在单滑问题上表现良好。 (b) 直接对多张幻灯片应用幻灯片级代理,缺乏有效的幻灯片选择和交叉滑行推理。 (c) PlanPath通过勘探规划、幻灯片排名和跨滑坡证据整合,解决患者层面的问题。

blocks.en: To address these challenges, we propose PlanPath , a pathology agentic framework for patient-level visual question answering. Given a patient-level question, PlanPath formulates an exploration plan that specifies the required diagnostic evidence and guides question-driven slide selection and cross-slide exploration. It then performs hierarchical cross-slide evidence acquisition, characterizing question-relevant regions through morphological observations, while tissue-level analysis provides spatial context and cell-level quantification is invoked when quantitative evidence is required. These complementary findings are integrated across slides at the patient level, with tissue- and cell-level analyses supporting measurements of areas, counts, proportions, and cross-slide distributions for questions that demand quantitative reasoning. Notably, as a general patient-level orchestration framework, PlanPath can adapt existing slide-level pathology agents to patient-level tasks.
blocks.zh: 为了应付这些挑战,我们提议PlanPath,一个病人视觉问题回答的病理学代理框架。 鉴于病人一级的问题,PlanPath制定了一项勘探计划,其中具体规定了所需的诊断证据,并指导由问题驱动的滑行选择和跨滑行勘探。 然后它进行分级的跨滑坡证据采集,通过形态学观测来描述与问题有关的区域,而组织层次分析则提供空间背景,在需要定量证据时引用细胞层次量化. 这些互补的发现在病人一级通过幻灯片进行整合,组织和细胞层面的分析支持对需要定量推理的问题进行区域、计数、比例和交叉滑坡分布的测量。 值得注意的是,PlanPath作为一个一般的患者级管弦框架,可以将现有的幻灯片级病理剂适应患者级的任务.

blocks.en: Moreover, to support systematic evaluation, we collaborate with pathologists to construct two patient-level pathology VQA datasets for renal and gastric cancer. Questions and reference answers are derived from original diagnostic records and available slide evidence, with explicit verification that the anatomical sites required to answer each question are supported by corresponding slides.
blocks.zh: 此外,为了支持系统评估,我们与病理学家合作,为肾癌和胃癌建造了两个病人一级的病理VQA数据集。 问答和参考解答取自原始诊断记录和可得到的幻灯片证据,明确核实回答每个问题所需的解剖站点有相应的幻灯片支持.

blocks.en: The main contributions of this work are summarized as follows: • We first formally define patient-level pathology VQA as a distinct task that requires reasoning over a patient’s collection of slides rather than individual slides. To tackle this task, we propose PlanPath , a patient-level pathology agentic framework for question-driven slide selection, cross-slide evidence acquisition, and complementary evidence integration. • We develop a multiscale evidence acquisition and quantitative analysis strategy that integrates slide-level context, tissue-level structure, and cell-level measurements, enabling aggregation of evidence for patient-level quantitative reasoning beyond isolated local observations. • We construct two patient-level pathology VQA datasets for renal and gastric cancer, comprising 3,245 WSIs from 213 patients and 1,623 pathologist-verified question–answer pairs, and use them as standardized benchmarks to systematically evaluate PlanPath and a broad range of existing methods under the patient-level setting.
blocks.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献概述如下: 我们首先正式将患者层面的病理VQA定义为一个不同的任务,它需要针对患者收集的幻灯片而不是个人幻灯片进行推理. 为了完成这项任务,我们提议PlanPath,一个病人一级病理学代理框架,用于问题驱动的幻灯片选择、交叉滑行证据获取和补充证据整合。 我们制定一种多尺度证据采集和定量分析战略,将滑行级环境,组织级结构和细胞级测量结合起来,使患者级定量推理的证据集合起来,超越了孤立的局部观察. • 我们为肾癌和胃癌构建了两个患者一级病理学的VQA数据集,其中包括来自213名患者的3,245个WSI和1,623个病理学家验证的回答对,并将其作为标准基准,系统地评估PlanPath和在患者一级环境下的各种现有方法。

To tackle this task, we propose PlanPath , a patient-level pathology agentic framework for question-driven slide selection, cross-slide evidence acquisition, and complementary evidence integration.

blocks.en: 2 Dataset Construction and Problem Formulation
blocks.zh: 2 数据集构建和问题制定

blocks.en: This section presents the construction and quality control procedures for two patient-level pathology visual question answering (PatientVQA) datasets, analyzes their scale, question types, and diagnostic content, and formally defines the task inputs, outputs, and objectives.
blocks.zh: 本节介绍两个患者级病理视觉问题回答(PatientVQA)数据集的构造和质量控制程序,分析其规模,问题类型和诊断内容,并正式定义任务输入,产出和目标.

blocks.en: 2.1 Patient-Level Pathology VQA Dataset Construction
blocks.zh: 2.1 患者一级病理学VQA 数据集建设

blocks.en: We construct PatientVQA-Gastric and PatientVQA-Renal using real-world pathology records from patients with renal and gastric cancer. We include patients with definitive diagnoses, collect the corresponding pathology reports, and organize WSIs from different sampling sites into patient-level slide collections. GPT-5.6 Sol is used to derive candidate question–answer pairs from the reports, with reference answers grounded in explicitly documented diagnostic findings. The questions cover tumor type, grade, local invasion, margin status, lymph node involvement, and pathological staging. For quality control, two pathologists cross-review the candidate pairs and exclude those with medical or logical errors, ambiguous wording, insufficient support from the reports, or inadequate visual evidence in the available slides. The retained pairs are linked to their corresponding patient-level slide collections to form the final datasets.
blocks.zh: 我们利用肾上腺癌和胃癌患者的真实病理学记录,构建了PatientVQA-Gastric和PatientVQA-Renal。 我们把确诊的病人包括进来,收集相应的病理报告,从不同的取样地点组织WSI到患者一级的幻灯片收集. GPT-5.6 Sol用于从报告中得出备选问答,参考答案以明确记录的诊断结论为依据。 问题包括肿瘤类型、等级、局部入侵、边缘状况、淋巴节点参与和病理中转。 关于质量控制,两名病理学家交叉审查候选对子,并排除那些有医疗或逻辑错误、措辞模糊、报告支持不足或可用幻灯片中视觉证据不足的人。 所保留的对子与其对应的患者级幻灯片集相链接,形成最终数据集.

blocks.en: 2.2 Dataset Statistics and Analysis
blocks.zh: 2.2 数据集统计和分析

blocks.en: The two datasets comprise 213 patients, 3,245 WSIs, and 1,623 question–answer pairs. PatientVQA-Gastric contains 104 patients, 2,227 WSIs, and 923 question–answer pairs, while PatientVQA-Renal contains 109 patients, 1,018 WSIs, and 700 question–answer pairs. The average numbers of slides per patient are 21.41 and 9.34, with ranges of 13–58 and 2–36, respectively, enabling evaluation across patient-level slide collections of varying sizes.
blocks.zh: 这两个数据集包括213个病人、3,245个西安病人和1,623个问答对。 PatientVQA-Gastric包含104个病人,2,227个WSI,以及923个问答对;而PatientVQA-Renal包含109个病人,1,018个WSI,以及700个问答对. 每个病人的平均滑行次数为21.41和9.34,分别为13-58和2-36,从而能够对不同大小的病人一级的滑行收集进行评估。

blocks.en: Both datasets include yes/no, single-answer multiple-choice (MCQ), and short-answer (Open) questions, accounting for 29.0%, 28.1%, and 42.9% of PatientVQA-Gastric, and 46.7%, 34.6%, and 18.7% of PatientVQA-Renal, respectively. These question types cover the presence of pathological findings, predefined diagnostic categories, and diagnostic answers. The diagnostic content covers tumor type, grade, local invasion, margin status, and pathological staging. Each patient is associated with multiple questions with varying slides and evidence requirements, supporting evaluation of morphological recognition, question-driven slide selection, and cross-slide evidence integration.
blocks.zh: 两个数据集都包括"是"/"否","单答多选"(MCQ),"短答"(开放)等问题,分别占患者VQA-Gastric的29.0%,28.1%和42.9%,以及患者VQA-Renal的46.7%,34.6%和18.7%. 这些问题类型包括病理学发现的存在,预先确定的诊断类别,以及诊断答案等. 诊断内容包括肿瘤类型、分级、局部入侵、边距状况和病理中转。 每个患者与多个问题相关联,并有不同的滑行和证据要求,支持对形态识别的评价,由问题驱动的滑行选择,并交叉滑行证据整合.

blocks.en: 3 Method
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of PlanPath. The Agent Brain plans and coordinates question-driven slide retrieval and cross-slide multiscale evidence acquisition, followed by iterative evidence integration for prediction, confidence estimation, and traceable reasoning.
blocks.zh: 图2:PlanPath概览。 Agent Brain计划和协调由问题驱动的幻灯片取回和跨滑行多尺度证据采集,然后是迭代证据集成,用于预测,信心估计和可追踪推理.

blocks.en: 3.1 Framework Overview
blocks.zh: 3.1 框架概览

blocks.en: We propose PlanPath , an agentic framework for patient-level pathology VQA. As illustrated in Fig. 2 , a unified Agent Brain coordinates the Slide Router , cross-slide navigation, and analysis tools: the Tissue-level Analysis Tool , Cell-level Quantification Tool , and Image Description Tool .
blocks.zh: 我们提议PlanPath, 患者一级病理的代理框架 VQA。 如图2所示,一个统一的Agent Brain协调了滑行路由器、跨滑行导航和分析工具:组织级分析工具、细胞级量化工具和图像描述工具。

blocks.en: The Agent Brain first constructs an exploration plan that specifies the required evidence, analysis scales, and stopping criteria, denoted as Question-driven Exploration Planning . Guided by this plan, the Slide Router retrieves relevant slides through Patient-level Slide Routing . PlanPath then performs Hierarchical Evidence Acquisition by progressively exploring candidate ROIs across slides and magnifications and invoking analysis tools as needed. All acquired evidence is stored with its source slide, ROI, magnification, and spatial lineage, enabling the patient-level Evidence Integration and Answer Generation to remain traceable to visual and quantitative evidence.
blocks.zh: Agent Brain首先构建了一个勘探计划,其中具体规定了所需的证据、分析尺度和停止标准,即由问题驱动的勘探规划。 根据这个计划,滑行路由器通过病人级滑行取回相关的滑行. PlanPath随后通过在幻灯片和放大片之间逐步探索候选ROI,并视需要利用分析工具来进行分级取证。 所有获得的证据都用其源代码幻灯片、ROI、放大和空间分界线来储存,使患者一级的证据整合和回答生成能够继续追踪到视觉和定量证据。

blocks.en: 3.2 Question-Driven Exploration Planning
blocks.zh: 3.2 问题驱动勘探规划

blocks.en: PlanPath first transforms the original question q q into a structured exploration plan that guides subsequent evidence acquisition: Π ⁡ ( q ) = ( 𝒟 , τ , 𝒯 , ℛ , 𝒢 ) , \Pi(q)=\left(\mathcal{D},\tau,\mathcal{T},\mathcal{R},\mathcal{G}\right), (2) where 𝒟 \mathcal{D} denotes a set of semantic descriptions used for slide retrieval, τ \tau represents the logical property of the question, 𝒯 \mathcal{T} specifies the target evidence, ℛ \mathcal{R} defines the required spatial resolutions and tool calls, and 𝒢 \mathcal{G} specifies evidence sufficiency and stopping criteria.

blocks.en:
According to their reasoning requirements, input questions are categorized into existential , exhaustive , extremum , quantitative , or composite types. These categories determine the required evidence coverage. For example, an existential question may terminate once reliable direct positive evidence is obtained, whereas patient-level negative conclusions, extrema, extent-related assessments, and other global judgments generally require broader slide coverage. The derived exploration plan also serves as a tool-routing mechanism.
Based on Π \Pi , the Agent Brain determines which analysis tools are required for the current question and specifies their roles in evidence acquisition. Tools irrelevant to the current question are excluded from the execution path. In conclusion, PlanPath does not apply a fixed analysis pipeline to every slide. Instead, it first determines what evidence is required and decides where, at what scale, and with which tools to acquire it.
blocks.zh:
根据其推理要求,输入问题分为存在、详尽、极端、数量或复合类型。 这些类别决定了所需的证据覆盖范围。 例如,一旦获得可靠的直接积极证据,存在性问题就可能终止,而病人的负面结论、极端、与范围有关的评估和其他全球判断一般需要更广泛的幻灯片覆盖。 衍生的勘探计划还起到工具出行机制的作用。
基于QQ\Pi,Agent Brain确定当前问题需要哪些分析工具,并明确了它们在取证中的作用. 与当前问题无关的工具被排除在执行路径之外. 总之,PlanPath并不对每张幻灯片采用固定分析管道. 相反,它首先确定需要何种证据,并决定在哪里、在何种规模和用何种工具获取证据。

blocks.en: 3.3 Patient-Level Slide Routing
blocks.zh: 3.3 病人级幻灯片运行

blocks.en:
The Slide Router identifies and prioritizes slides that are likely to contain evidence relevant to the current question.
Given the patient WSI collection 𝒮 \mathcal{S} and the retrieval descriptions D D specified in the exploration plan Π \Pi , it produces a relevance-ranked candidate slide pool for evidence acquisition. The Slide Router is used only to determine the order and scope of exploration.
Routing scores are not considered diagnostic evidence and do not directly contribute to the final answer.
Any retrieved slide must undergo ROI-level analysis before it can support a patient-level conclusion.

blocks.en: Notably, the extent of candidate coverage is also determined by the question type τ \tau . For focal existential findings, PlanPath prioritizes high-ranking slides and may terminate once sufficient positive evidence is obtained. For negative, exhaustive, extremum, or extent-related tasks, broader coverage is maintained to reduce the risk of missing critical evidence that appears only on a subset of slides.

blocks.en: 3.4 Hierarchical Evidence Acquisition
blocks.zh: 3.4 等级证据的获取

blocks.en: For each candidate slide, PlanPath adopts a coarse-to-fine strategy to progressively localize, inspect, and quantify question-relevant pathological evidence across multiple spatial scales. Specifically, evidence acquisition is organized around three complementary components: tissue context, morphological observation, and cell-level quantification.
blocks.zh: 对于每个候选幻灯片,PlanPath采用从粗到细的战略,在多个空间尺度上逐步确定、检查和量化与问题有关的病理证据。 具体而言,证据采集围绕三个互补部分进行:组织环境、形态观察和细胞一级量化。

blocks.en: Coarse-to-Fine ROI Selection. PlanPath first establishes global tissue context from low-magnification views and identifies candidate ROIs according to the exploration plan. Each candidate ROI R R is prioritized based on semantic relevance, tissue context, and image quality: s ⁡ ( R ) = α ​ s sem ​ ( R ) + β ​ s tissue ​ ( R ) + γ ​ s quality ​ ( R ) , s(R)=\alpha s_{\mathrm{sem}}(R)+\beta s_{\mathrm{tissue}}(R)+\gamma s_{\mathrm{quality}}(R), (6) where the three terms measure question-related semantic relevance, consistency with target tissue structures, and image quality, respectively. High-priority ROIs are progressively examined at higher magnifications while preserving their parent–child spatial relationships.

PlanPath首先从低放大角度确定全球组织背景,并依照勘探计划确定候选ROI。 每个候选的ROI R根据语义关联性,组织上下文,图像质量优先排序: s → (R) = α sem (R) + β s 组织 (R) + γ s 质量 (R), s (R) → (alpha s_{\ mathrm{ sem}} (R) → βbeta s_{\ mathrm{ tissues}} (R) → (+\) s_{\gamma s_{\ mathrm{ matr}} (R)) (6) 三个术语分别衡量与问题相关的语义相关性,与目标组织结构的一致性,和图像质量. 高度优先 在保持父母与子女之间的空间关系的同时,在更高的放大度下,逐步对ROI进行检查。

blocks.en: Tissue-Level Analysis. When tissue composition, lesion extent, or spatial interfaces are relevant to the question, the Tissue-level Analysis Tool extracts tissue regions, areas, distributions, and interfaces from the WSI. These outputs provide global spatial context and guide subsequent ROI selection rather than directly determining the diagnosis. For quantitative tasks, tissue-level measurements can further support the estimation of areas, proportions, and spatial distributions.
blocks.zh: 组织层面分析。 当组织组成,损伤程度,或空间界面与问题相关时,组织层面分析工具会从WSI中提取组织区域,区域,分布和界面. 这些产出提供了全球空间背景,并指导随后的ROI选择,而不是直接决定诊断. 对于定量任务,组织层面的测量可以进一步支持对区域,比例,空间分布的估算.

blocks.en: Morphological Observation. For selected ROIs, the Image Description Tool generates morphological observations at the corresponding magnification. Low-magnification views characterize tissue architecture and spatial organization, whereas higher-magnification views capture cellular arrangement and fine-grained morphology. To separate visual observation from diagnostic reasoning, the tool describes the visible pathological findings rather than directly predicting the final answer.

blocks.en: Cell-Level Quantification. When quantitative evidence is required, the Cell-level Quantification Tool analyzes selected high-magnification ROIs to obtain cell counts, proportions, densities, and spatial statistics. Quantification is restricted to ROIs satisfying relevance, image-quality, and tissue-coverage requirements, with each measurement linked to its source slide and ROI.

blocks.en: Implementation Details. The Agent Brain in PlanPath is instantiated with Qwen3.5-4B ( Qwen Team, 2026 ) , while the Slide Router is implemented using TITAN ( Ding et al., 2025 ) . The Tissue-level Analysis Tool employs a prototype-guided tissue segmentation model, the Cell-level Quantification Tool uses HistoPLUS ( Adjadj et al., 2026 ) , and the Image Description Tool is based on Patho-R1-7B ( Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Cross-slide navigation is jointly driven by the tissue-level analysis results and PLIP ( Huang et al., 2023 ) : tissue maps provide spatial context, while PLIP evaluates the semantic relevance between candidate regions and the current evidence requirements. Together, these components support slide selection, multiscale evidence acquisition, and patient-level evidence integration. Details of each component are provided in Appendix B .

blocks.en: 4.2 Main Results on Patient-Level Pathology VQA
blocks.zh: 4.2 关于病人一级病理学的主要结果

blocks.en: Table 1 presents the main results on PatientVQA-Gastric and PatientVQA-Renal. PlanPath achieves the best overall performance on both benchmarks. On PVQA-Gastric, PlanPath reaches a Total Accuracy of 60.24%, outperforming the strongest baseline by 9.43 percentage points. It also achieves the best performance on MCQ, Yes/No, and open-ended questions. The improvement is particularly notable for open-ended questions, where PlanPath achieves an accuracy of 55.05%. On Renal, the performance improvement is even more pronounced. PlanPath achieves a Total Accuracy of 72.71%, exceeding the strongest baseline by 12.14 percentage points. It reaches an MCQ accuracy of 78.51% and an open-ended accuracy of 56.49%. Overall, these results demonstrate that question-driven slide selection and cross-slide evidence integration are particularly effective for patient-level pathology VQA tasks that require integrating complementary information distributed across multiple WSIs.
blocks.zh: 表1列示了PatientVQA-Gastric和PatientVQA-肾脏的主要结果. PlanPath在这两项基准上都取得了最佳的总体业绩。 在PVQA-Gastric上,PlanPath的总准确度达到60.24%,比最强基线高9.43个百分点。 它还在MCQ、是/否和开放式问题上取得了最佳业绩。 在无限制的问题方面,这种改善特别显著,PlanPath的准确度达到55.05%。 在Renal上,表现的改善更为明显. PlanPath的总准确度为72.71%,超过最强基线12.14%。 它达到了78.51%的MCQ精度和56.49%的开放式精度. 总的来说,这些结果表明,由问题驱动的幻灯片选择和跨滑行证据整合对于患者一级病理VQA任务特别有效,这些任务需要整合分布在多个世界安全局之间的互补信息.

blocks.en: We evaluate the compatibility of PlanPath with three representative slide-level pathology agents: PathAgent, PathNavigate, and GIANT. As shown in Fig. 3 , integrating PlanPath consistently improves all three agents on both patient-level datasets. On Gastric, the gains range from 7.72 to 8.02 percentage points, while improvements of 3.00–6.15 points are observed on Renal. These consistent gains demonstrate that PlanPath can effectively extend different slide-level agents to patient-level multi-slide reasoning without relying on a specific underlying agent. Detailed performance changes across individual question types are provided in Appendix C.3 .

blocks.en: 4.4 Quantitative Reasoning and Inference Efficiency
blocks.zh: 4.4 定量理由和推断效率

blocks.en: We further evaluate PlanPath in terms of quantitative reasoning and inference efficiency. As shown in Table 2 , PlanPath consistently outperforms representative pathology agents under different quantitative evaluation criteria, achieving 38.89% exact match and 61.11%, 72.22%, 72.22%, and 83.33% accuracy under tolerance thresholds of ± 5 \pm 5 , ± 10 \pm 10 , ± 15 \pm 15 , and ± 20 \pm 20 , respectively.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步从定量推理和推论效率的角度评价PlanPath. 如表2所示,PlanPath在不同的定量评价标准下一直比代表性病理剂表现好,分别达到38.89%和61.11%、72.22%、72.22%和83.33%的耐受阈值,分别为±5\pm 5、±10\pm 10、±15\pm 15和±20\pm 20。

blocks.en: Meanwhile, Table 3 compares prompt token consumption on the closed-ended question subset common to all methods, including BEACON, for fair comparison. On this cohort, PlanPath requires 164.32K and 120.03K tokens per question on Gastric and Renal, respectively, substantially fewer than PathAgent, PathNavigate, GIANT, and BEACON. These results indicate that question-driven slide routing and hierarchical evidence acquisition reduce unnecessary processing of irrelevant slides and redundant visual information while maintaining patient-level reasoning performance.
blocks.zh: 同时,表3比较了包括BEACON在内的所有方法共同使用的封闭式问题子集的快速象征性消费,以便进行公平比较。 对于这批人,PlanPath在胃和Renal的每个问题上分别需要164.32K和120.03K令牌,大大低于PathAgent、PathNavigate、GIANT和BEACON。 这些结果表明,由问题驱动的幻灯片路由和分级证据的获取减少了对不相干幻灯片和冗余视觉信息的不必要处理,同时保持了患者的推理性能.

blocks.en: 4.5 Ablation and Case Study
blocks.zh: 4.5 读取和个案研究

blocks.en: Table 4 evaluates key PlanPath components. Removing the Slide Router reduces accuracy from 65.62% to 64.02%, confirming the importance of question-driven slide selection. Removing the Tissue-level Analysis Tool causes the largest drop of 3.57 percentage points, highlighting the role of tissue context in relevant-region exploration. Removing Cell-level Quantification yields a smaller decrease to 65.19%, suggesting a more task-dependent benefit. Removing both tissue- and cell-level tools further degrades performance, supporting the value of multiscale evidence acquisition.
blocks.zh: 表4评价了PlanPath的关键组成部分。 删除滑行路由器将精度从65.62%降低到64.02%,证实了由问题驱动的滑行选择的重要性. 删除组织级分析 工具造成最大下降3.57个百分点,突出组织环境在相关区域探索中的作用. 取消细胞一级量化的结果较小地下降到65.19%,这表明更依赖任务的好处。 移除组织与细胞层面的工具会进一步降解性能,支持多尺度证据获取的价值.

blocks.en: Figure 4 presents a quantitative VQA case. A slide-level agent analyzes WSIs independently and produces inconsistent estimates, leading to an inaccurate answer. PlanPath formulates an exploration plan, retrieves question-relevant slides, and performs cross-slide tissue-level, cell-level, and morphological analysis. When evidence is insufficient, it retrieves tumor-bearing slides. By integrating evidence across slides and scales, PlanPath estimates approximately 90%, consistent with the reference answer, demonstrating the value of question-driven slide selection, multiscale analysis, and iterative cross-slide evidence integration. Additional Case studies are provided in Appendix D .

blocks.en: 5 Related Works
blocks.zh: 5 相关工程

blocks.en: Pathology Foundation and Vision–Language Models. Recent pathology foundation models have improved transferable representation learning for histopathology. Vision foundation models such as Virchow ( Vorontsov et al., 2024 ) , Prov-GigaPath ( Xu et al., 2024 ) , and CHIEF ( Wang et al., 2024 ) learn generalizable morphological representations through large-scale pretraining. Vision–language models such as PLIP ( Huang et al., 2023 ) and CONCH ( Lu et al., 2024a ) align pathological images with natural language. Approaches, including PathChat ( Lu et al., 2024c ) , TITAN ( Ding et al., 2025 ) , SlideChat ( Chen et al., 2025b ) , and WSI-LLaVA ( Liang et al., 2025 ) , extend multimodal understanding and visual question answering to whole-slide images. These advances provide strong foundations for pathological representation learning and image–text reasoning, but most still operate on predefined image inputs or individual WSIs and do not explicitly address question-driven evidence acquisition and integration across multiple slides from the same patient.
blocks.zh: 病理学基金会与展望-语言模型. 最近的病理学基础模型改善了可转移的病理学表现学。 Virchow(Worldows等,2024年),Prov-Gigapath(Xu等,2024年),CHIEF(Wang等,2024年)等远景基础模型通过大规模预训学习通俗形态表现. 视觉-语言模型如PLIP(黄等,2023年)和CONCH(陆等,2024年a)将病理图像与自然语言相配合. 方法,包括PathChat(Lu等,2024c),TITAN(Ding等,2025),幻灯片 Chat (Chen等,2025b),和WSI-LLAVA (Liang等,2025),扩展了多模式理解和视觉问题解答全滑行图像. 这些进步为病理表现学习和图像-文字推理提供了坚实的基础,但大多数仍然以预先定义的图像输入或单个的WSI操作,并且没有明确处理由问题驱动的证据获取和来自同一病人的多张幻灯片的整合.

blocks.en: Pathology Agents for Whole-Slide Image Reasoning. Recent pathology agents have further moved beyond static WSI prediction toward active diagnostic evidence acquisition through ROI localization, magnification adjustment, tool invocation, and iterative reasoning. Representative approaches such as PathAgent ( Chen et al., 2025a ) , GIANT ( Buckley et al., 2025 ) , and PathNavigate ( Yang et al., 2026 ) demonstrate the effectiveness of adaptive evidence acquisition for whole-slide image reasoning. However, most existing methods ( Ghezloo et al., 2025 ; Lyu et al., 2025 ; Ge et al., 2026 ) remain focused on within-slide exploration and primarily reason from local visual observations. They provide limited support for selecting question-relevant slides from a patient’s WSI collection, dynamically expanding the slide search when evidence is insufficient, and systematically aggregating quantitative evidence across slides. PlanPath extends pathology agents from within-slide navigation to patient-level cross-slide evidence acquisition and integration.
blocks.zh: 全滑成像的病理学代理人. 近期的病理学代理人已经进一步超越了静态的WSI预测,转向通过ROI本地化,放大调整,工具引用,和迭代推理获取活性诊断证据. PathAgent(Chen等,2025年a),GIANT(Buckley等,2025年),PathNavigate(Yang等,2026年)等具有代表性的方法,证明了全滑图像推理的适应性证据获取的有效性. 然而,大多数现有方法(Ghezloo等人,2025年;Lyu等人,2025年;Ge等人,2026年)仍然注重于滑坡内部的探索,主要来自当地视觉观察. 它们为从患者的WSI收集中选择与问题有关的幻灯片提供有限的支持,在证据不足时动态地扩大幻灯片搜索,并系统地汇总跨幻灯片的定量证据。 PlanPath将病理剂从滑行内导航延伸到患者层面的横行滑行证据获取和整合.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: In this work, we formally define patient-level pathology visual question answering and propose PlanPath , a patient-level agentic framework for question-driven slide selection, hierarchical evidence acquisition, quantitative analysis, and cross-slide integration. We also construct two patient-level VQA datasets for renal and gastric cancer to support systematic evaluation. Experiments demonstrate the effectiveness of PlanPath and its compatibility with existing slide-level pathology agents. We hope this work advances pathology agents from single-slide analysis toward more comprehensive patient-level reasoning.
blocks.zh: 在这部作品中,我们正式定义了患者层面的病理视觉问题答案,并提出了PlanPath(英语:PlanPath),一个患者层面的代理框架,用于由问题驱动的幻灯片选择,分级获取证据,定量分析,并跨滑坡融合. 我们还为肾癌和胃癌构建了两个患者一级的VQA数据集,以支持系统评价。 实验证明了PlanPath的有效性及其与现有滑行级病理剂的相容性. 我们希望这项工作能够将病理分析剂从单滑分析推进到更全面的患者层面推理。

blocks.en: B.1 Model Parameter Settings

blocks.en: The model configurations and inference parameters of the main PlanPath modules are summarized in Table 7 . The Agent Brain is implemented with Qwen3.5-4B, consisting of 32 layers with a hidden size of 2560, and is responsible for exploration planning, evidence verification, and final answer generation. The Morphology Description Tool employs Patho-R1-7B (Qwen2.5-VL) with a context length of 8,192 tokens and single-image input to generate question-independent morphological descriptions. The Slide Router uses TITAN to extract 768-dimensional WSI embeddings and rank all slides of a patient according to text–WSI semantic similarity. For candidate region retrieval, PLIP encodes each ROI with an input size of 224 × 224 224\times 224 and produces 512-dimensional features for semantic relevance ranking.
blocks.zh: 表7概述了主要PlanPath模块的模型配置和推论参数。 代理大脑由Qwen3.5-4B执行,由32个层组成,隐藏大小为2560个,并负责勘探规划,证据核实,以及最后的答案生成. 口感描述工具使用Patho-R1-7B(Quen2.5-VL),上下文长度为8,192个符和单相像输入来生成问题独立的形态描述. 滑行路由器使用TITAN来提取768维的WSI嵌入并按文本-WSI语义相似度对患者的所有幻灯片进行排序. 对于候选区域检索,PLIP编码了每个ROI,输入大小为224×224/224\times 224,并产生了512维特性,用于语义相关性排名.

blocks.en: The Tissue-level Analysis Tool operates on a pre-constructed Tissue Feature Prototype Bank with 768-dimensional feature representations. The softmax temperature for prototype matching is set to 0.04, enabling localization of target tissues, tissue interfaces, and morphologically heterogeneous regions. For cell-level analysis, the Cell-level Quantification Tool employs HistoPLUS with dedicated models at 20 × 20\times and 40 × 40\times magnifications. Both models use an input size of 784 × 784 784\times 784 , with the cell confidence threshold set to 0.50, supporting cell detection, instance segmentation, classification, and density quantification.
blocks.zh: 组织层面的分析 工具在前所构建的有768维特性表示的"Feature Prototype Bank"上运行. 用于原型匹配的软马克斯温度被设定为0.04,使目标组织,组织界面和形态多样性区域得以本地化. 对于细胞层分析,细胞层量化工具使用HistoPLUS的专用模型在20×20相和40×40相放大. 两种模型都使用784×784784\times 784的输入大小,细胞置信阈值被设定为0.50,支持细胞检测,实例分化,分类,密度量化.

blocks.en: To support coarse-to-fine hierarchical evidence acquisition, PlanPath adopts scale-specific WSI cropping and analysis settings at 5 × 5\times , 20 × 20\times , and 40 × 40\times , as summarized in Table 8 . At 5 × 5\times , a 4096 × 4096 4096\times 4096 region is cropped from the Level-0 WSI to capture tissue architecture, lesion distribution, and tumor interfaces; HistoPLUS is not activated at this scale. At 20 × 20\times , the Level-0 crop size is reduced to 1024 × 1024 1024\times 1024 for examining cellular organization, epithelial lesions, and local tumor–vessel/nerve relationships. HistoPLUS can be invoked at this scale with a resolution of 0.50 ​ μ ​ m / px 0.50~\mu\mathrm{m}/\mathrm{px} . At 40 × 40\times , a 512 × 512 512\times 512 Level-0 region is used for detailed inspection of nuclear and cytoplasmic morphology, tumor subtype, mitotic figures, and subtle suspicious foci, with HistoPLUS operating at 0.25 ​ μ ​ m / px 0.25~\mu\mathrm{m}/\mathrm{px} .

Across all observation scales, the input to Patho-R1 is resized to 512 × 512 512\times 512 , while the PLIP input is standardized to 224 × 224 224\times 224 . These scale-specific settings provide a consistent interface across modules while enabling PlanPath to progressively transition from tissue-level structural assessment to local morphological inspection and cell-level quantification during hierarchical evidence acquisition.
blocks.zh: 在所有观测尺度上,Patho-R1的输入被调整为512×512 512\times 512;而PLIP的输入被标准化为224×224 2.24\times 224. 这些针对规模的设置提供了模块之间一致的界面,同时使得PlanPath能够在分级取证过程中从组织层面的结构评估逐步过渡到局部形态检查和细胞层面量化.

blocks.en: B.2 Implementation of Slide Router
blocks.zh: B.2 实施幻灯片路由器

blocks.en: The Slide Router is used only to determine the priority order in which the WSIs of the current patient are examined. Its outputs consist of the ranked slides and their corresponding routing scores, which are not treated as histopathological evidence. The inputs include all WSIs from the same patient and the slide-level retrieval descriptions generated by the Agent Brain for the current question.
blocks.zh: 滑行路由器仅用于确定当前患者的WSI检查的优先顺序. 其产出由排名的幻灯片及其相应的路由分数组成,不作为组织病理学证据来对待. 输入内容包括来自同一患者的所有WSI和由Agent Brain为当前问题生成的幻灯片级检索描述.

blocks.en: For each question, the Agent Brain generates 1 1 – 3 3 concise English caption-style descriptions that characterize the tissue appearances that should be preferentially searched for at the slide level. These descriptions may include dataset-level organ context, but do not contain slide filenames, specimen-site labels, or reference answers. For Yes/No questions, the retrieval descriptions cover both the target finding and an assessable contrasting state. For MCQ questions, they cover the major morphological axes associated with different candidate answers, thereby avoiding a retrieval direction dominated by a single option. All retrieval descriptions are used only for slide ranking and do not directly participate in downstream answer generation.
blocks.zh: 每个问题, Agent Brain 生成 11– 3 个简洁的英文字幕风格描述,描述在幻灯片级别上应该优先搜索的组织外观. 这些描述可能包括数据集级器官上下文,但不包含幻灯片文件名,标本站点标签,或参考答案. 对于“是/否”问题,检索说明既包括目标查找,也包括可评估的对比状态。 对于MCQ问题,它们涵盖了与不同候选答案相关联的主要形态轴,从而避免了被单一选项所支配的检索方向. 所有回取描述仅用于幻灯片排名,不直接参与下游回取生成.

blocks.en: By default, the top 5 5 analyzable slides form the initial candidate pool. The pool size is further adjusted according to the evidence requirements of the current question.
blocks.zh: 默认情况下,前5名5可分析滑行构成初始候选池. 池规模根据本期问题的证据要求作进一步调整.

blocks.en: For extremum-seeking tasks or focal spatial-interface tasks, the candidate pool is expanded to include at least the top 8 8 slides. For coverage-sensitive tasks that require sufficient support for patient-level negative, extremum, or counting conclusions, all analyzable slides are retained. Examples include assessment of the deepest gastric wall invasion and pT stage, perineural or lymphovascular invasion, renal capsular involvement, and regional lymph-node status or pN stage.
blocks.zh: 对于极端搜索任务或焦距交互任务,候选集合被扩展至至少包括前8个8个幻灯片. 对于需要足够支持患者水平负数、极限数或计数结论的覆盖敏感任务,保留所有可分析幻灯片。 例子包括评估最深的胃壁入侵和pT相位,围膜或淋巴血管入侵,肾盖参与,以及区域淋巴-节点状态或pN相位.

blocks.en: Candidate slides are subsequently processed by ROI-level analysis in routing order. For presence-detection questions, exploration may terminate early once direct positive evidence passes the Evidence Gate. In contrast, tasks requiring sufficient candidate-pool coverage continue to inspect the remaining slides until the predefined coverage and stopping criteria are satisfied.
blocks.zh: 候选幻灯片随后由ROI级分析按路由顺序处理. 对于在场-探测问题,一旦直接的正证据通过证据门,勘探活动可提前终止。 与此相反,需要足够候选人队伍覆盖的任务继续检查所剩幻灯片,直至达到预定覆盖范围和停止标准。

blocks.en: A slide is included in the effective candidate pool only when its global representation, original WSI, and the data required for downstream ROI analysis are all accessible. Slides missing a global representation cannot be assigned a routing score. Slides that can be ranked at the slide level but lack the original image or ROI-analysis data are marked as unanalyzable and excluded from the candidate pool. All missing or exclusion states are recorded in the execution log. If all slides of a patient lack valid global representations, the Slide Router terminates the routing process and returns an error state.
blocks.zh: 只有当其全球代表性(原始的WSI)和下游ROI分析所需的数据全部可以获取时,才能在有效候选人才库中包含幻灯片. 缺少全局代表的幻灯片不能被指定路径分数 。 在幻灯片级别上可以排名但缺乏原始图像或ROI分析数据的幻灯片被标记为不可分析并被排除在候选集合之外. 所有缺失或排除状态都记录在执行日志中. 如果患者的所有幻灯片都缺乏有效的全局表示,则幻灯片路由器会终止路由过程并返回出错状态.

blocks.en: To reduce repeated computation across multiple questions from the same patient, the system caches text representations, slide representations, and complete ranking results. The text-cache key is determined by the normalized set of retrieval descriptions. The slide-representation cache is bound to the corresponding representation file, while the persistent ranking cache is further conditioned on the current question, Evidence Plan, model state, and slide state. Any change in the relevant inputs triggers recomputation.
blocks.zh: 为了减少重复计算同一患者的多个问题,系统会缓存文本表达,幻灯片表达,并完成排名结果. 文本缓存密钥由已规范的一组检索描述决定. 幻灯片表示缓存绑定在相应的表示文件上,而持续的排名缓存则进一步以当前问题,证据计划,模型状态,和幻灯片状态为条件. 相关投入的任何变化都会引发重算.

blocks.en: The caching mechanism only reuses deterministic intermediate results under identical inputs. It introduces no additional clinical information and does not modify the candidate-pool construction or stopping rules. Regardless of whether a ranking is obtained through real-time computation or cache reuse, the similarity scores, ranking positions, and matched retrieval descriptions produced by the Slide Router are used solely to determine the subsequent slide exploration order. They are not treated as diagnostic evidence and are not directly propagated to final answer generation.
blocks.zh: 缓存机制只在相同的投入下再利用确定性中间结果。 它不引入额外的临床信息,也不修改候选集合构建或停止规则. 无论排名是通过实时计算还是缓存再利用获得,相近性分数,排名位置,以及幻灯片路由器制作的相匹配的检索描述,都完全用于确定后一幻灯片探索顺序. 它们不被视为诊断性证据,也不被直接传播给最后的答案生成者。

blocks.en: B.3 Implementation of Tissue-Level Analysis Tool
blocks.zh: B.3 实施组织层面分析工具

blocks.en: The Tissue-level Analysis Tool is a weakly supervised spatial analysis module based on tissue feature prototypes. Rather than directly diagnosing an ROI, it converts a WSI into a spatial tissue map with soft class probabilities, providing a unified representation for target-region retrieval, tissue composition quantification, and tissue-interface localization. The module consists of three stages: tissue prototype bank construction, patch-level prototype matching, and region-level spatial aggregation.
blocks.zh: 组织层面的分析 工具是一个基于组织特征原型的被弱监督的空间分析模块. 它不直接诊断ROI,而是将WSI转换为具有软类概率的空间组织图,为目标区域检索,组织组成量化,组织界面局部化提供统一代表. 该模块由三个阶段组成:组织原型库建设,补丁级原型配对,以及地区级空间聚合.

blocks.en: The prototype bank is constructed once during development. During inference, patch representations are extracted from the current WSI and matched against the fixed prototype bank to generate a soft tissue map. Question-independent patch representations and tissue maps are cached to avoid redundant computation across multiple questions from the same slide.
blocks.zh: 原型库在开发期间建造一次. 在推论期间,从目前的WSI中提取出补丁表示并和固定原型库相配以生成软组织图. 提问独立的补丁表示和组织图被缓存,以避免从同一张幻灯片对多个问题进行冗余计算.

blocks.en: The gastric prototype bank was constructed from TCGA-STAD , comprising 1,051 WSIs and 1,944,093 pathology patch representations of 768 dimensions. The renal prototype bank was constructed from TCGA-RCC , comprising 934 WSIs and 3,408,240 patch representations. All patch representations were first L 2 L_{2} -normalized and then clustered using MiniBatch K K -means with K = 100 K=100 . The mini-batch size was set to 8,192, with three initializations and a fixed random seed of 42.
blocks.zh: 胃原型库由TCGA-STAD所建,由1,051个WSI和1,944,093个768维的病理学补丁表示组成. 肾原型库由TCGA-RCC所建造,由934个WPIS和3,408,240个补丁表示组成. 所有补丁表达式先是L 2 L_{2}-正态化,再用MiniBatch K-用K=100 K=100来组合. 小批量大小被设定为8,192个,有3个初始化,固定随机种子为42个.

blocks.en: For each cluster, the 30 high-resolution patches closest to the cluster center were manually reviewed to determine the dominant tissue category, morphological purity, and secondary tissue components. After review, 11 tissue categories were retained for TCGA-STAD and 8 for TCGA-RCC. Because hemorrhagic regions in TCGA-STAD did not form an independent dominant cluster, 16 additional patches with a purity of at least 0.90 were selected from mixed clusters to supplement the hemorrhage category.

blocks.en: B.4 Baseline Settings
blocks.zh: B.4 基线设置

blocks.en: For a fair comparison, all baseline methods follow their official implementations and recommended inference settings unless otherwise specified. We use Qwen3.5-4B as the unified model for patient-level output aggregation across all applicable baselines. For slide-level pathology agents, Qwen3.5-4B is additionally used for within-slide evidence integration and final slide-level answer generation, ensuring a consistent reasoning backbone across agentic baselines. Each WSI is first processed independently according to the corresponding baseline pipeline, after which the resulting slide-level outputs are aggregated by Qwen3.5-4B into a single patient-level answer. Apart from these unified integration and aggregation settings, all model architectures, visual encoders, preprocessing procedures, tool configurations, and inference parameters follow the official baseline implementations.
blocks.zh: 为了进行公平的比较,除非另有说明,所有基准方法都遵循其正式实施和建议的推论设置。 我们使用Qwen3.5-4B作为所有适用基线中病人一级产出汇总的统一模型。 对于滑行级病理剂,Quen3.5-4B被额外用于滑行内证据集成和最终的滑行级解答生成,确保跨剂基线的推理主干线一致. 每个WSI首先按照相应的基线管进行独立处理,之后产生的滑行级输出被Quen3.5-4B汇总为单一患者级答案. 除了这些统一的集成和集合设置,所有模型架构,视觉编码器,预处理程序,工具配置,和推论参数都遵循了官方的基准执行.

blocks.en: C.2 Comparison of Baseline Aggregation Strategies
blocks.zh: C.2 基线聚合战略比较

blocks.en: To examine whether baseline performance depends on how independently generated slide-level predictions are combined, we compare majority voting with Qwen3.5-4B aggregation, which is used for the baseline results in the main text. Both strategies operate on the same saved slide-level predictions, while the underlying visual inference remains unchanged.
blocks.zh: 为了检查基线性能是否取决于独立生成的滑行水平预测是如何结合的,我们比较多数投票和Qwen3.5-4B汇总,在正文中用于基准结果. 这两种策略都运行在相同的被保存的幻灯片平面预测上,而基本的视觉推断则保持不变.

blocks.en: Each non-empty and parseable slide-level answer contributes one vote, and the most frequent answer is selected as the patient-level prediction. For open-ended questions, model-specific parsers extract concise answers by removing answer prefixes and truncating at predefined sentence or punctuation boundaries. The extracted answers are normalized for case, whitespace, hyphens, and predefined grade expressions before identical answers are grouped. Empty or unparseable outputs are excluded. If no valid answer remains, the patient-level prediction is set to None and counted as incorrect. Ties are resolved using prediction confidence when available, followed by a deterministic model-specific rule if necessary.
blocks.zh: 每个非空和可解析的滑行级答案都贡献一票,最常被选为患者级预测. 对于开放式的问题,模型特定解析器通过去掉答案前缀和在预定义的句子或平分边界上取出简洁的答案. 提取的答案在组合相同答案之前,对大小写,白空格,连字符和预定义的等分表达式进行常态化. 不包括空出或无法分割的产出。 如果没有有效的答案,病人的预测将被设定为无,并算作不正确。 利用已有的预测信心来解决问题,必要时再制定确定模式的具体规则。

blocks.en: Qwen3.5-4B receives the question, answer options when applicable, and all valid slide-level answers from the same patient, and selects a single patient-level answer. For open-ended questions, it is instructed to return the selected answer verbatim without paraphrasing, merging, or expanding it. The aggregation model receives no images, pathology reports, or reference answers.
blocks.zh: Quen3.5-4B接收提问,在适用的情况下回答选项,以及同一患者所有有效的幻灯片级解答,并选择单一的患者级解答. 对于无限制的问题,指示它返回所选答案的逐字记录,而无需解释、合并或扩展。 汇总模型没有收到图像、病理报告或参考答案。

blocks.en: Tables 12 and 13 report the results using majority voting, while the corresponding Qwen3.5-4B aggregation results are reported in the main-text Table 1 . The effect of aggregation varies across baselines, with majority voting improving some methods while reducing others. On PatientVQA-Gastric, the strongest baseline under majority voting achieves 53.30% Total Accuracy, compared with 60.24% for PlanPath, corresponding to a 6.94 percentage-point difference. Under Qwen3.5-4B aggregation, the strongest baseline achieves 50.81%, corresponding to a 9.43-point difference. On PatientVQA-Renal, the strongest baseline reaches 60.43% with majority voting and 60.57% with Qwen3.5-4B aggregation, compared with 72.71% for PlanPath, yielding differences of 12.28 and 12.14 percentage points, respectively. These results show that the performance advantage of PlanPath is maintained under both baseline aggregation strategies.
blocks.zh: 表12和表13以多数票报告结果,而对应的Quen3.5-4B汇总结果则在正文表1中报告。 汇总的效果因基线而异,多数表决改进了某些方法而减少了其他方法。 关于PatientVQA-Gastric,多数投票下最强的基准达到53.30%的总准确度,而PlanPath为60.24%,相当于6.94个百分点的相差. 在Quen3.5-4B聚合下,最强基线达到50.81%,相当于9.43分相差. 关于PatientVQA-肾脏,最强基线达到60.43%,获得多数票,60.57%获得Quen3.5-4B汇总,而PlanPath为72.71%,差距分别为12.28%和12.14%。 这些结果表明,PlanPath在两个基线汇总战略下都保持了业绩优势。

blocks.en: Table 14 reports the per-dataset and per-question-type ablation results corresponding to the overall results in the main text. Removing the Tissue-level Analysis Tool causes the largest and most consistent degradation, reducing Total Accuracy by 3.79 and 3.28 percentage points on PatientVQA-Gastric and PatientVQA-Renal, respectively. The Slide Router also contributes to both datasets, with particularly clear effects on Gastric open-ended questions and Renal MCQ performance. Removing the Cell-level Quantification Tool produces a smaller overall decrease, with most of its effect concentrated on open-ended questions. These results further show that the contributions of individual components are task-dependent and not strictly additive across question types.

blocks.en: Appendix D Additional Qualitative Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录D 定性分析

blocks.en: We provide five additional examples from PatientVQA-Gastric and PatientVQA-Renal to complement the case study in Fig. 4 . These examples illustrate how PlanPath translates a patient-level question into an exploration plan, acquires relevant evidence across slides and magnifications, and integrates the resulting observations into a final answer. The visualizations highlight different evidence requirements for quantitative estimation, cross-slide assessment, and question-specific lesion identification.
blocks.zh: 我们提供了PatientVQA-Gastric和PatientVQA-肾脏的另外五个例子,以补充Fig的案例研究。 4 (韩语). 这些例子说明了PlanPath如何将病人层面的问题转化为勘探计划,如何通过幻灯片获取相关证据并放大,以及如何将由此产生的观测结果纳入最终答案。 可视化突出了对定量估计、交叉滑坡评估和特定问题损害识别的不同证据要求。

blocks.en: D.1 Visualization of Quantitative Reasoning Cases
blocks.zh: D.1 量化理由案件的可视化

blocks.en: Figures 9 and 10 present two examples of histological component estimation. Answering these questions requires identifying the target morphology and assessing its extent within the tumor. PlanPath therefore combines tissue-level spatial context, ROI-level morphological observations, and cellular measurements to support area-based aggregation across the selected slides.
blocks.zh: 图9和图10提供了组织学部分估计的两个实例。 回答这些问题需要确定目标形态并评估其在肿瘤中的程度。 因此,PlanPath结合了组织层面的空间环境、ROI层面的形态观测和细胞测量,以支持在选定的幻灯片上按区域进行聚合。

blocks.en: Signet-ring component. Figure 9 addresses a question targeting poorly cohesive cells with intracytoplasmic mucin vacuoles and displaced nuclei. Some 20 × \times fields show cohesive glandular or trabecular structures without definite signet-ring morphology, prompting further exploration. Subsequent 40 × \times observations provide supporting cellular detail, which is integrated with tissue-level information to obtain an estimate of approximately 10%. This case illustrates how phenotype-specific retrieval and higher-magnification inspection support estimation of a component with limited extent.
blocks.zh: 信号环组件 。 图9涉及一个针对细胞内粘膜杆菌和转移核细胞的缺乏凝聚力的细胞的问题。 大约20 ×\times 字段显示有凝聚力的腺体或轨迹结构,没有明确的标志环形态,从而促使进一步探索。 之后的40×x\times观测提供了辅助细胞细节,细胞细节与组织层次信息相融合,以获得约10%的估计数. 这一案例说明了苯型特定检索和高放大度检查如何支持对有限范围的部件的估计。

blocks.en: Hepatoid component. In Fig. 10 , PlanPath searches for trabecular or solid arrangements of polygonal cells. Higher-magnification observations reveal granular eosinophilic cytoplasm and prominent nucleoli in representative regions. Evidence acquired from five candidate slides supports an estimated hepatoid proportion of approximately 30%. Together, these cases show how component-specific morphology and tissue-level extent contribute complementary information to patient-level quantitative reasoning.
blocks.zh: 肝脏成分。 入法义. 10,PlanPath搜索多边形细胞的曲面或固态排列. 高放大观测显示,在代表性区域,颗粒性卵泡细胞和突出的核糖体。 从5个候选幻灯片获得的证据支持大约30%的肝脏比例。 这些病例加在一起,显示了特定成分形态和组织层面的程度如何为患者层面的定量推理提供补充信息.

blocks.en: D.2 Visualization of Cross-Slide Patient-Level Reasoning
blocks.zh: D.2 跨滑行病人-水平理由的可视化

blocks.en: Figures 11 , 12 , and 13 illustrate cross-slide reasoning for tumor focality, margin status, and additional lesion identification. These tasks differ in both the evidence to be acquired and the conditions under which exploration can terminate. PlanPath maintains the association between each observation and its source tissue while integrating complementary findings across the patient’s slides.
blocks.zh: 图11、图12和图13说明了肿瘤致病性、比值状况和额外损伤识别的交叉推论。 这些任务在获得的证据和终止勘探的条件方面各不相同。 PlanPath 保持了每次观测与其源组织之间的联系,同时整合了患者幻灯片上的互补发现.

blocks.en: Primary tumor foci. Figure 11 illustrates the use of spatial relationships in focus counting. PlanPath first localizes separate tissue components and then examines their cellular content at higher magnification. After reviewing five candidate slides, it identifies two independently supported foci. Aggregation preserves the distinction between spatially separate foci and repeated appearances across sections: the final count uses the maximum independently confirmed count within a section, without summing serial-section observations.
blocks.zh: 初等肿瘤 图11显示在重点计数中利用空间关系的情况。 PlanPath首先将单独的组织成分定位,然后在更高的放大度下检查它们的细胞含量. 在审查了五个候选幻灯片之后,它确定了两个独立支持的焦点。 聚合保留了空间相分离的基数和跨节相重复的外观的区别:最终计数使用一节内独立确认的最大计数,而无需进行串行分数观测.

blocks.en: Renal resection margin. In Fig. 12 , the exploration targets the relationship between epithelial cells and the submitted resection edge. An inked-edge observation shows no epithelial crossing, but this local finding does not immediately end the search. PlanPath continues until all four candidate slides have been examined and integrates the relevant edge and interface observations, returning no carcinoma identified . The example illustrates the broader evidence requirement for a negative margin assessment.
blocks.zh: 雷纳尔重新剖析比值。 在图12中,勘探的目标是表征细胞与所提交的再分解边缘之间的关系。 一个有刺网的观测显示没有上下穿行,但是这个局部发现并没有立即结束搜索. PlanPath一直持续到所有四个候选幻灯片都经过检查并整合了相关的边缘和界面观测结果, 这个例子说明了对负差值评估更广泛的证据要求。

blocks.en: Additional simple cyst. In Fig. 13 , the first examined slide does not establish the required cystic architecture. Exploration then moves to another candidate, where 20 × \times observations reveal a single cuboidal epithelial lining with uniform nuclei and no stratification or significant atypia. These findings support a simple cyst , allowing PlanPath to stop after examining two of the five candidates. The decisive evidence is supplied by tissue architecture and lining-cell morphology.
blocks.zh: 额外的简单的囊肿. 在图13中,第一张被检查的幻灯片没有建立所需的囊状结构. 然后探索到另一个候选者,其中20 ×分秒观测显示,一个单立体上皮衬里有统一的核,没有分层或显著的阿提比亚. 这些结果支持一个简单的囊肿,让PlanPath在对5名候选人中的2名候选人进行检查后停下来. 决定性的证据由组织架构和衬里细胞形态学提供.

blocks.en: Figure 9: Patient-level estimation of the signet-ring component. The exploration plan targets poorly cohesive cells with intracellular mucin and displaced nuclei. Higher-magnification observations provide phenotype-specific support, which is integrated with tissue-level quantitative evidence to estimate a proportion of approximately 10%.
blocks.zh: 图9:指示环成分的患者水平估计。 勘探计划的目标是细胞内黏液和转移核的凝聚性差的细胞. 高放大观测提供了酚类特异性支持,与组织层面的定量证据相融合,估计比例约为10%.

blocks.en: Figure 10: Patient-level estimation of the hepatoid component. PlanPath examines trabecular and solid tumor regions and acquires higher-magnification evidence of polygonal cells with eosinophilic cytoplasm. Quantitative integration across the selected slides yields an estimated proportion of approximately 30%.
blocks.zh: 图10:肝脏成分的患者水平估计。 PlanPath检查了曲面和固态的肿瘤区域,并获得了多边形细胞具有异氧细胞瘤的较高放大度证据. 在整个选定的幻灯片中进行定量整合的比例估计约为30%。

blocks.en: Figure 11: Cross-slide assessment of primary tumor focality. Tissue-level localization identifies spatially separate candidate components, and higher-magnification observations confirm their cellular content. Integration yields two independently supported foci while avoiding repeated counting across serial sections.
blocks.zh: 图11:初级肿瘤致病性交叉滑坡评估. 组织级本地化识别出空间上独立的候选成分,更高放大度的观测确认了它们的细胞含量. 整合产生两个独立支持的基点,同时避免跨序列段重复计数.

blocks.en: Figure 12: Cross-slide assessment of the renal resection margin. PlanPath localizes relevant cut-edge relationships and continues exploration after an initial negative finding to satisfy the four-slide candidate coverage requirement. The integrated answer is no carcinoma identified at the margin.
blocks.zh: 图12:肾脏分解比值跨滑坡评估. PlanPath将相关接地关系本地化,并在初步否定结论后继续探索,以满足四条滑坡候选覆盖要求. 综合答案是,没有在比值上识别出癌。

blocks.en: Figure 13: Identification of an additional simple cyst. Targeted exploration reveals cystic architecture and a single bland cuboidal lining, providing sufficient positive evidence after two candidate slides. Cellular views provide morphological context.
blocks.zh: 图13:确定另一个简单的囊肿。 目标明确的探索揭示出囊肿结构以及单一的平地立体衬垫,在两个候选幻灯片后提供了足够的正证据. 细胞观提供形态上下文.
